'''Jayke Ball EBO 7 is your lucky number''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Jayke Ball]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-11022">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11022 EBO 7 is your lucky number], DeckTech (Jayke "Lord_vader20" Ball, 9 October 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/11022/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/11022/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018111414/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11022/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jayke Ball]]
* '''Published:''' 9 October 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''EBO 7 is your lucky number''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 E7IYLN Ball LS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits Hoth Shield Generator: not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' Uses the Echo Base ops theme. Force Draines big and retreaves lots.

== Original post ==

'''EBO 7 is your lucky number'''
* '''Author:''' Jayke "Lord_vader20" Ball
* '''Published:''' October 9, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 3.0
* '''Description:''' Uses the Echo Base ops theme. Force Draines big and retreaves lots.

=== Strategy ===

Set up your echo sites using A new secret base. Get a rebel there and hive him or her the binoculors. Then get 3 baraquins so you can lose 3 devices or weapons to force drain and then just retrive them. This works really well.  If your good at tracking destinies, this deck is for you. With 10 7's in there, you can win battles insanly even with only 2 red squad x-wings. Make shure you get a 7 for on the edge so you can retrieve 6 force. This deck works really well, I hope you have fun with it.
